accessDis: The Director of Discipline sees behaviour and boarding records.
accessDos: The Director of Studies manages timetables, results and academic records.
accessMatron: The Matron sees health and boarding information.
accessNote: These rules are enforced on the server, not merely hidden in the interface. Sensitive administrative actions are written to an audit log recording who did what and when.
accessParents: Parents see only their own children.
changesBody: If this statement changes materially, schools using Imboni are notified. Continued use after a change indicates acceptance of the revised statement.
childrenBody: Most of what Imboni holds is about minors, and it includes categories that are sensitive in any jurisdiction: health, and disciplinary history. We treat that as the constraint it is. Where a design choice trades convenience against exposure of a pupil's record, we take the less convenient option.
closing: This statement describes technical and organisational practice. It is not legal advice, and it does not replace the privacy notice your school is required to publish to parents.
holdsBody: Imboni stores what a school needs to operate: identity and contact details for pupils, parents and staff; academic records including marks, attendance and assignments; health information such as blood group, allergies and medical conditions; behaviour and boarding records; and fee status. Passwords are never stored, only one-way hashes of them.
intro: This page describes Imboni's practices as the provider of the software. Each school using Imboni is the data controller for its own pupils' records and publishes its own privacy notice to parents. If you are a parent or pupil, ask your school for theirs.
isolationBody: Every school is given its own isolated database schema. Two schools do not share tables and are not separated by a filter in application code that could be got wrong. A query running for one school cannot return another school's rows, because those rows are not in the tables it is reading.
isolationTitle: Schools are separated at the database level
notCollectBody: Our error monitoring is configured never to capture personal data. Grades, medical notes, disciplinary records, request bodies, email addresses and authentication tokens are excluded from bug reports, so they are not sent off-site when something breaks. This is a deliberate setting, not a default.
notCollectTitle: What we deliberately do not collect
notSell: We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.
protectBackup: The database is backed up automatically each night.
protectHash: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes and are not recoverable.
protectThrottle: Repeated failed logins are rate limited to frustrate guessing.
protectTls: All traffic is encrypted in transit using TLS.
protectTwoFactor: Two-factor authentication is available on staff accounts.
retentionBody: Schools decide how long to keep records, guided by their own legal obligations. Imboni provides a data erasure process so a school can remove an individual's personal data when it is no longer required or when a valid request is made.
rightsBody: Requests to access, correct, or erase personal data are made to the school holding the record, since the school is the controller. If you are unsure who to contact, or your school cannot help,
rightsBodyEnd: and we will direct the request appropriately.
subtitle: How Imboni handles the information schools trust us with.
title: Privacy and data protection
